metadataRaw.title: 30 SECOND FIX: Lower Back & SI Joint Pain Relief
metadataRaw.description:
Dr. Rowe shows how to instantly relieve lower back and sacroiliac joint (SI joint) pain.

Pain in this area is usually caused by a combination of weakness and tightness in the main muscles that support it, including the glutes, piriformis, and quadratus lumborum.

To fix this, the video is divided into two parts. The first part focuses on releasing tight muscles for quick relief, while the second part focuses on strengthening these muscles for long-lasting relief.

Each part and exercise works differently. For the best results, try them all and use what gives the most relief.

Watch now and fix lower back and sacroiliac joint pain for good!

Link to therapy ball: https://amzn.to/3E7XN2H

0:00 Intro
